limitations: No source 10-K PDFs or FinanceBench question data are present in the checkout.
No poisoned PDFs are present, so the injection probes cannot be tied to actual poisoned documents.
No financial answer or physical PDF page citation can be verified.

This is a 45-question provisional question inventory, not a scored or frozen ground-truth benchmark. Replace the unverified placeholders and fill expected answers and citations after the actual corpus and poisoned PDFs are supplied.
